title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 4: the bronze altar, the molten sea, the basins, lamp stands and tables, and Huram's bronze work for the temple.

questions.text: What were the measurements of the bronze altar?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:1 says the bronze altar was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

answers.text: Ten cubits long, ten wide, and five high
Thirty cubits long, ten wide, and twenty high
Five cubits long, five wide, and three high
Twenty cubits long, twenty wide, and ten high

questions.text: On how many oxen did the molten sea stand?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:4 says the sea stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward each direction.

questions.text: How much did the molten sea receive and hold?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:5 says it received and held three thousand baths.

questions.text: What was the molten sea used for?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:6 says the things for the burnt offering were washed in the basins, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

answers.text: For the priests to wash in
For washing the things of the burnt offering
For storing the oil of the lamps
For the king to bathe in

questions.text: How many basins of gold were made?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:8 says he made one hundred basins of gold.

questions.text: With what were the doors of the court overlaid?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:9 says he overlaid the doors of the court with bronze.

questions.text: How many pomegranates were made for the two networks?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:13 says there were four hundred pomegranates for the two networks.

questions.text: Where did the king cast the bronze vessels?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:17 says he cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

answers.text: In the plain of the Jordan, between Succoth and Zeredah
In Lebanon, near the city of Tyre
In Jerusalem, near the threshing floor
In the valley near the city of Joppa

questions.text: What does the text say about the weight of the bronze?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:18 says Solomon made the vessels in great abundance, for the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

answers.text: It was exactly three thousand talents
It was written in the book of the kings
It was weighed by Huram every day

questions.text: Of what were the inner doors for the most holy place made?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 4:22 says the inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall were of gold.
